acceptance.text: Review intended documentation, workflow, intake, map and supporting check files; preserve unrelated work.
acceptance.evidence: Reviewed and explicitly staged all 105 intended documentation/workflow/intake/map/supporting-check files (~3 MB). Staged paths exactly match the reviewed manifest, caches are excluded and historical unassigned logs are unchanged. No unrelated working-tree paths were found.
acceptance.how: Inspect the actual diffs, source/task/license evidence and a fixed explicit path manifest; stage only reviewed project files.

acceptance.text: Pass delivery checks and inspect the staged changes before creating scoped commits.
acceptance.evidence: 31 intake/location tests, 46 workflow tests, five Node syntax checks, lint, production build, workflow validation and git diff/staged whitespace checks pass. Staged source, CI, dependency/license and record diffs inspected; commit is the next action.
acceptance.how: Run intake/location, workflow, validation, syntax, lint, build and diff checks; inspect the staged diff and create descriptive commits.
acceptance.verification: Actual check outputs and actual commit hashes are recorded, without self-referential commit identities or invented review.

acceptance.text: Push the authorized feature branch and verify the remote revision without accepting review/science gates.
acceptance.how: Push without force to the requested origin branch and verify its advertised revision and upstream tracking.
acceptance.verification: Remote ref matches the pushed commit; tasks remain in_review and physical-phone/Prachurjo review stays pending.
